newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in HK Toy Centre shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in HK Toy Centre shares suspended.

text.p: Toymaker Hong Kong Toy Centre International Ltd said on Tuesday it had requested a trading suspension in its shares pending further notice.
The company shares ended one cent up at HK$0.88 on Monday.

Hong Kong Toy Centre said Pacific Margin International Ltd, a unit of United Pacific Industries Ltd, held 309.71 million shares or 87.8 percent of the company at the close of a public offer on Monday.

"Since less than 25 percent of the issued share capital of the company remains in public hands, shares will be placed out as soon as possible to independent third parties," Hong Kong Toy Centre said in the statement.
The company said an application would be submitted for a resumption of trading in its shares on completion of a placement.

In March, controlling shareholders of Hong Kong Toy Centre agreed to sell a 47.27 percent stake to Pacific Margin, which required it to make a general offer for all of the toymaker's outstanding shares on completion of the deal.
